digest.component_or_area: CI workflow and external integration test harness
propositions: A parameterized CI harness under tests/external/ must evaluate (provider, model, directive-variant) cells with n=10 production-shaped prompts, capturing raw replies and scoring deterministically by parse success and layout-class distribution.
The sentinel directive measurably changes raw-output layout from mixed (fenced/multi-object) to 100% prose on Anthropic and Bedrock, and raises parse-success rates on all three provider arms.
Missing API credentials must be recorded as 'unmeasured' cells without failing the job; call-budget cap (default 300 calls/run) is enforced before any network call.

Unit tests must validate scorer reproduction of golden counts on committed E2 fixtures, credential-absent skip path, and call-budget enforcement; live workflow_dispatch runs are operator-triggered and scored deterministically offline against pre-declared thresholds.
